_sheet: What the mod reads from the player's own ROUNDS install at runtime. One row = one asset or file. Nothing here is shipped; it is loaded from the ROUNDS folder found through Steam's library list. Verified against research/rounds-out/rounds_inventory.json (preflight checks names and formats).

_columns.kind: file | monobehaviour | texture | sprite | audio | scene
_columns.name: asset name (for audio/texture/sprite) or class name (for monobehaviour)
_columns.usedFor: where it shows up in the mashup
_columns.required: true = the mashup cannot deal cards without it; false = graceful fallback
_columns.fallback: what happens when it is missing

rows.name: sharedassets0.assets
rows.format: Unity serialized file (7.4 MB), type trees stripped
rows.usedFor: the 67 pool card prefabs, card art textures, UI sounds

rows.name: globalgamemanagers.assets
rows.format: Unity serialized file (0.36 MB) holding the MonoScript class names
rows.usedFor: resolving which MonoBehaviour is a CardInfo

rows.name: Card Choice
rows.format: Unity scene file; CardChoice MonoBehaviour with cards[] (the live pool) and cardThemes[] (9 theme colours)
rows.usedFor: which cards are in ROUNDS's real pool and the exact theme colours
rows.fallback: pool = all sharedassets0 CardInfo; theme colours from the built-in table copied from this scene (research/rounds_themes.json)

rows.name: Assembly-CSharp.dll
rows.format: .NET assemblies, read as metadata only with Mono.Cecil
rows.usedFor: building MonoBehaviour field layouts (CardInfo, CardInfoStat, LocalizedString, CardChoice, CardThemeColor, Image)

rows.name: CardInfo
rows.format: fields: cardName, cardDestription, m_localizedCardName, m_localizedCardDescription, cardStats[] {positive, amount, simepleAmount, stat, m_localizedStat}, rarity, cardArt, sprite, cardColor, allowMultiple, colorTheme
rows.usedFor: card name, text, stats, rarity, theme

rows.name: StringTableCards_en-US
rows.usedFor: current English card names, descriptions, stat labels and AMOUNT_* phrases
rows.fallback: legacy cardName/cardDestription/stat strings stored on each card

rows.name: UI_Card_Pick_01..05
rows.format: AudioClip Vorbis in FSB5, stereo 48 kHz 1.8 s

rows.name: UI_Card_Switch_01..08
rows.format: AudioClip Vorbis in FSB5, mono 48 kHz 0.16 s

rows.name: UI_Cards_Appear_01..03
rows.format: AudioClip Vorbis in FSB5, stereo 48 kHz 0.74 s

rows.name: UI_Button_Hover_01..05
rows.format: AudioClip Vorbis in FSB5, mono 48 kHz 0.03 s
